blocks.text: This article provides information about the Manager software; details about the Manager version; details about the App Connector, Private Service Edge for Private Access (ZPA), Private Cloud Controller, and Network Connector software versions; and upgrades to all.

When you first deploy the software, a server is required to run the software. The server is available using a virtual machine (VM). The VMs run a service called zpa-connector for App Connectors, zpa-service-edge for Private Service Edges, zpa-pcc for Private Cloud Controllers, and np-connector for Network Connectors. To learn about installing the service on your own server, see the App Connector Deployment Guides for Supported Platforms, Private Service Edge Deployment Guides for Supported Platforms, and Private Cloud Controller Deployment Guides for Supported Platforms, and the Network Connector Deployment Guide for Linux.

The Manager is the zpa-connector, zpa-service-edge, zpa-pcc, or np-connector software that is needed to manage the App Connector, Private Service Edge, Private Cloud Controller, or Network Connector components.

The Manager software downloads a new software, (e.g., zpa-connector-child),that establishes Microtunnels (M-Tunnels) and talks to the internal applications. This child software facilitates access to internal applications for Private Access users.

blocks.heading: Manager Version and Current Software Version

blocks.text: The purpose of the Manager software is to supervise and control the App Connector (zpa-connector-child), Private Service Edge (zpa-service-edge-child), Private Cloud Controller (zpa-pcc-child), or Network Connector (np-connector-child) software. The version of the Manager requires frequent updates. New features are constantly being added, and these features involve new functionality in App Connectors, Private Service Edges, Private Cloud Controllers, and Network Connectors. The child software (e.g., zpa-connector-child) does the primary work and also gets updated frequently.

The Manager software uses the OS trusted Certificate Authority (CA) bundle for establishing a TLS connection to download software. The CentOS CA bundle can be found at the following location: /etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted/pem/tls-ca-bundle.pem
Use the following command to update the CentOS CA bundle: sudo update-ca-trust
The Manager software is what makes the upgrades possible.

blocks.item: Manager Upgrades

The Manager upgrades mean upgrading the zpa-connector, zpa-service-edge, zpa-pcc, or np-connector software. If you are using Linux software packages, the Manager software must be upgraded manually in the software component's console using the following command:
sudo yum upgrade
This command upgrades all software packages on the server, including the Manager software.
To upgrade only the zpa-connector package, use the following command:
sudo yum upgrade zpa-connector
To upgrade only the zpa-service-edge package, use the following command:
sudo yum upgrade zpa-service-edge
To upgrade only the zpa-pcc package, use the following command:
sudo yum upgrade zpa-pcc
To upgrade only the np-connector package, use the following command:
sudo yum upgrade np-connector
All commands include the upgrade of the Manager software.

The Manager software is included in upgrades to the host operating system (OS). Zscaler recommends periodically updating the App Connector, Private Service Edge, Private Cloud Controller, or Network Connector host OS using the sudo yum update -y command. To learn more, see Updating the Host OS and Software Packages.
App Connector Upgrades
App Connector upgrades mean upgrading the zpa-connector-child software. To learn more, see Understanding Software Updates in Private Access.
Private Service Edge Upgrades
Private Service Edge upgrades means upgrading the zpa-service-edge-child software. To learn more, see Understanding Software Updates in Private Access.
Private Cloud Controller Upgrades
Private Cloud Controller upgrades mean upgrading the zpa-pcc-child software. To learn more, see Understanding Software Updates in Private Access.
Network Connector Upgrades
Network Connector upgrades means upgrading the np-connector-child software. To learn more, see Understanding Software Updates in Private Access.
